outcome: incidence of complications (fetal distress, meconium-stained liquor)
cohort: A total of 100 primigravid women with singleton, term pregnancies and spontaneous onset of labor were randomly assigned to two groups.
finding: Both oral misoprostol and intravenous oxytocin effectively augment labor in primigravid women; misoprostol is easier to administer and store but is associated with a higher incidence of fetal distress and meconium staining, although neonatal outcomes were comparable.
